# Brightwater Contact Import and Cleanup Runbook
Monthly contact update | Prepared 04/15/2026

## Run details
Owner: Naomi Maddox, Administrative Assistant
Reviewer: Maria Banerjee
Database: Brightwater Community Center outreach contacts
Source file: April_Contacts.xlsx, saved in the shared Operations folder

The source file contains 184 active contacts. Before importing, save a working copy as April_Contacts_Import.xlsx and confirm that the email and ZIP code columns are formatted as text. The source workbook's control sheet lists the verified record counts:

| Source-file status | Count |
| --- | ---: |
| Active contacts | 148 |
| Inactive contacts | 36 |
| Total rows | 184 |
| Exact duplicate pairs | 12 |

## Import procedure
Filter the Status column to Active and export only those rows to a CSV file. Check that the CSV has 148 data rows, excluding the header, before uploading it to the outreach database. Map First Name, Last Name, Email, ZIP Code, and Status to their matching database fields. Do not map the spreadsheet's internal Notes column; it contains staff-only comments.

Because all 12 duplicates are exact matches, delete both copies in each pair. After cleanup, compare the database's active-contact count with the 148 active rows in the source file and record the result in the April Operations Log. Wendy Osei, the database coordinator, should receive the completed log by 04/17/2026.

## Closeout
Keep the original workbook unchanged in the shared Operations folder. Save the cleaned CSV and the import confirmation in the April 2026 subfolder. Record the import date, row count, and any rejected-row messages in the log before closing the task.

errors.quote: The source file contains 184 active contacts.
errors.explanation: The control-sheet table lists 148 active contacts and 36 inactive contacts, totaling 184 rows. The sentence incorrectly describes the total row count as the active-contact count.
errors.fix: The source file contains 148 active contacts.

errors.quote: delete both copies in each pair
errors.explanation: Deleting both records in each of the 12 duplicate pairs removes every contact in those pairs. To clean up duplicates while retaining the contacts, one copy of each pair must remain.
errors.fix: delete one copy in each pair
